payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each '(' position i, compute combinations C(a+b-1, a) using prefix '(' count a and suffix ')' count b, summing modulo 1e9+7.
payload.rationale: Uses precomputed factorials and inverse factorials to directly compute combinatorial sums, avoiding DP recurrence. This matches dp_counting_combinatorics as it counts combinations with combinatorics.
